entries.institution: National Laboratory of the Rockies / former NREL
entries.title: Cost Projections for Utility-Scale Battery Storage: 2025 Update
entries.role: Direct evidence for LFP 4 h annual trajectory in evidence-direct primary pathway; 2030 mid anchor for equal-horizon sensitivity
entries.claim_boundary: Does not provide VRFB/PSH learning trajectories or province-specific siting potential.

entries.title: Energy Storage Cost and Performance Database v2024
entries.role: Direct 2030 Point / 100 MW benchmark for VRFB and PSH; CAES/H2 pressure-test benchmarks only
entries.claim_boundary: Gravitational and hydrogen values remain older estimates in v2024; CAES/H2 lack province-level geology/resource ledgers and cannot support headline provincial siting claims.

entries.institution: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Electricity
entries.title: Findings from Storage Innovations 2030: Flow Batteries
entries.role: Evidence context and claim boundary only; supports why flow batteries remain a plausible LDES design option
entries.claim_boundary: SI2030 LCOS/innovation portfolio results combine multiple cost/performance mechanisms and are not used as a direct CAPEX multiplier.

entries.institution: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Electricity
entries.title: Findings from Storage Innovations 2030: Pumped Storage Hydropower
entries.role: Evidence context and performance cross-check; V20 still enforces inherited zone PSH resource ceiling
entries.claim_boundary: PSH cost/resource feasibility is site-specific; model-zone result is not station-level engineering siting.

entries.institution: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Electricity
entries.title: Achieving the Promise of Low-Cost Long Duration Energy Storage
entries.role: Evidence tier firewall only; documents innovation upside but is not a deterministic deployment-cost forecast
entries.claim_boundary: Report explicitly addresses innovation/RD&D pathways; V20 does not treat LCOS reduction as a whole-system CAPEX learning factor.

entries.title: China energy-storage industry/data source snapshot packaged with V19
entries.role: Context and provenance; no unsupported technology learning extrapolation
entries.claim_boundary: Not used to infer generic post-2030 technology cost declines.

entries.institution: China hydropower / pumped-storage industry report source snapshot
entries.title: Pumped-storage industry development report 2024
entries.claim_boundary: Does not replace site-level PSH feasibility or create generic cost learning curves.

entries.institution: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Electricity
entries.title: Technology Strategy Assessment Methodology: Storage Innovations 2030 Technical Process
entries.role: Evidence-methodology firewall only; not a deterministic CAPEX forecast and not a numerical model-input trajectory
entries.claim_boundary: RD&D pathway methodology is used to interpret innovation evidence; it does not justify converting LCOS or innovation targets into BAU CAPEX multipliers.

entries.institution: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Electricity
entries.title: Findings from Storage Innovations 2030: Compressed Air Energy Storage
entries.role: Pressure-test evidence context only; not used as a direct CAPEX learning curve or province-level resource supply curve
entries.claim_boundary: CAES requires location/geology-specific feasibility; without a 32-zone geologic resource ledger V20 cannot make headline provincial deployment claims.

entries.institution: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Electricity
entries.title: Findings from Storage Innovations 2030: Bidirectional Hydrogen Storage
entries.role: Pressure-test evidence context only; not used as a direct CAPEX learning curve or province-level hydrogen-resource prescription
entries.claim_boundary: Hydrogen LCOS depends strongly on electricity and infrastructure assumptions; V20 does not convert SI2030 innovation results into deterministic BAU CAPEX or provincial siting claims.
